title: Arabic Ecommerce Translation & Copywriting
description: I’m preparing to launch an Arabic storefront and I want every word to feel as if it were written by a friendly salesperson who happens to be your best friend. I therefore need two tightly-linked tasks handled by a native Arabic copywriter with solid English skills and proven ecommerce experience. First, I’ll send you the full set of website strings—pages, menu labels, footer policies, and any micro-copy hidden in widgets. Your job is to render all of it into natural, casual-friendly Arabic. No literal lifts, no machine output; it must read smoothly and match the warm, approachable tone already on the English site. Second, I have 500 products waiting for fresh titles and descriptions in BOTH languages. You’ll craft persuasive, SEO-aware copy that highlights benefits, answers likely questions, and nudges shoppers to click “Add to Cart”. I’ll supply a keyword list as well as a handful of competitor links so you can mirror the vibe that works while keeping the wording 100 % original. Deliverables • Complete Arabic translation of the existing website content (all pages and UI text) • 500 product titles + short descriptions in English and Arabic, delivered in Excel or Google Sheets When you place your bid, let me know: – Your price per product (title + description in both languages) – How many products you can finish each day – The total timeline for the full 500 – A couple of samples that show similar ecommerce work you’ve done I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right partner, so feel free to ask any clarifying questions. Looking forward to seeing how you can bring my catalogue to life for Arabic shoppers.

title: English-Arabic Legal Translation Certification
description: I need an accredited credential that will officially attest to my ability to translate between English and Arabic at a professional level while analysing legal texts—particularly those dealing with intellectual property rights. The certification must be recognised by employers and capable of satisfying a “qualification for a specific job” requirement I am pursuing. My priority is clear, verifiable proof of high-precision bilingual communication skills across complex IP contracts, patents, licensing agreements, and related documentation. Any assessment or coursework you design should therefore blend rigorous translation accuracy checks with targeted legal-terminology challenges drawn from patent statutes, trademark filings, and technology-transfer agreements. Deliverables • Accredited certificate bearing my name, date, issuing authority, and a brief scope statement highlighting English-Arabic translation and intellectual-property text analysis. • Score report or transcript outlining the modules completed and the competencies demonstrated. • Verification method (online registry, QR code, or direct contact email) so prospective employers can confirm authenticity. Acceptance criteria • Issuing body must be an institute, university, or professional association that can be independently verified online. • Assessment material may be proctored live or remotely but must include both directions of translation and legal-analysis components. • Total processing time from enrolment to certificate issuance should not exceed four weeks. If you already partner with, represent, or are authorised by a qualifying institution and can handle the full process—application, testing, evaluation, and certification—please outline the pathway, timeline, and any documentation I need to provide.

Looking forward to working together!
